---

<div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.85em;">
<div>

`r if (isTRUE(getOption("housepi.footer.warranty"))) paste0(
  cli::symbol$warning,
  " ",
  "For illustration only.",
  " ", 
  "Results carry no warranty for health decisions."
)`

`r if (isTRUE(getOption("housepi.footer.sample"))) paste0(
  cli::symbol$warning,
  " ",
  "Number of steps were reduced for demonstration.",
  " ",
  "Increase them in realistic applications."
)`

`r paste0(
  cli::symbol$info,
  " ",
  paste(utils::capture.output(sessionInfo())[1:3], collapse = ". "),
  "."
)`

</div>
</div>
